distortions: “获罪被贬为庶人” compresses the sequence: Li Yan was nearly executed, then spared after Jiang Wan’s appeal and exiled as a commoner.
“吓退司马懿” is broadly accurate but simplifies his mistaken belief that the vehicles used a supernatural shrinking-distance technique.
“孔明设空城旗火” is imprecise: the empty camp deception was arranged before Zhang He’s pursuit, while the ambush at Mumen involved planned feigned retreats and concealed troops.
language_problems: “披发持剑的兵” is understandable but less natural than “披发仗剑的士兵” or “披发持剑的士卒”。
